prp.objective: Add a checkpoint-scoped `latest:user` pre-persist guard to the `mulligan_rewind` tool (`src/tools/rewind.ts`) — the TOOL half of BUG-003 (spec/06 §8 defense-in-depth). The sibling filter-layer fix (P1.M2.T2.S1 — `protectedOk` `latest:user` branch) is ALREADY shipped and live in `filterPipeline`; this task closes the TOOL layer so a `checkpoint` rewind whose resolved `remove` set CONTAINS the index of the LAST `role:"user"` message REFUSES at the tool (returns the shared `Mulligan: refused — …` text) BEFORE `renderNote`/`appendRewindMarker`/`leaveNote` — persisting ZERO markers and ZERO notes (no stray artifacts). The guard sits after the existing step-5b `last_turn`/`to_previous_prompt` nuclear guard, mirrors its refuse-and-return shape, is NARROWLY scoped to `granularity === "checkpoint"` (last_turn default is construction-safe — `resolveLastTurn` only removes indices AFTER iLastUser — so NO redundant guard is added there), and is config-gated on `config.rewind.protectedRoles` including `"latest:user"` (the default). Add 3 tests to `test/tools/rewind.test.ts`: (1) the BUG-003 repro (checkpoint targetId precedes a LATER user message → refused, `pi.appendEntry` NOT called for a rewind marker, `pi.sendMessage`/note NOT called); (2) a positive control (checkpoint that does NOT cross latest:user still succeeds — no over-refusal); (3) a config-gate control (`protectedRoles` omits `latest:user` → guard does not fire → tool proceeds).
implementationSteps: MODIFY src/tools/rewind.ts `resolvePreview` — widen its return type to `{ ledger: FileLedger; k: number; hideEntryIds: string[]; remove: number[]; messages: MessageLike[] }` and change ONLY the return statement to `return { ledger, k: remove.length, hideEntryIds, remove, messages };` (both `remove` and `messages` are already local vars in the body; no other line in resolvePreview changes). MessageLike is already imported from ../transforms.js.

MODIFY src/tools/rewind.ts rewindExecute — in the resolvePreview call-site block (~step 5): add `let remove: number[];` and `let messages: MessageLike[];` to the declarations before the try; change the destructure to `({ ledger, k, hideEntryIds, remove, messages } = resolvePreview(ctx, params, toolCallId));`; in the catch body add `remove = [];` and `messages = [];` (with a comment: empty snapshot → iLatestUser=-1 → the checkpoint guard no-ops; the filter's protectedOk backstops). Preserve the existing catch assignments (ledger=emptyLedger(); k=0; hideEntryIds=[]) and the E13/E8 comment. Do NOT touch step-5b.

MODIFY src/tools/rewind.ts rewindExecute — insert the step-5c checkpoint latest:user guard AFTER step-5b and BEFORE renderNote (step 6): `if (granularity === "checkpoint" && config.rewind.protectedRoles.includes("latest:user")) { let iLatestUser = -1; for (let i = 0; i < messages.length; i++) { const m = messages[i]; if (m && typeof m === "object" && (m as MessageLike).role === "user") iLatestUser = i; } if (iLatestUser !== -1 && remove.includes(iLatestUser)) return refusal("would cross a protected message (checkpoint rewind would remove the latest user message — the current ask)", "checkpoint"); }`. Reuse the existing refusal() helper and the existing `config` (read at step 1). Scope to checkpoint ONLY. Refusal text is VERBATIM (em-dash + parentheses). Add a step-5c comment citing BUG-003 tool layer + spec/06 §8 + the construction-safety note for last_turn.

successCriteria.description: A `checkpoint` rewind whose resolved `remove` set contains the index of the LAST `role:"user"` message returns `Mulligan: refused — would cross a protected message (checkpoint rewind would remove the latest user message — the current ask).` (refusal text VERBATIM) and persists ZERO markers (pi.appendEntry not called for mulligan:rewind) and ZERO notes (pi.sendMessage not called).
A `checkpoint` rewind whose `remove` does NOT contain iLatestUser still SUCCEEDS (no over-refusal): marker + note persisted, success text names granularity + K (positive control).
When config.rewind.protectedRoles omits "latest:user" (e.g. ["first:user"]), the guard does NOT fire — the checkpoint rewind proceeds and is not refused at the tool layer (config-gate control).
The guard is scoped to `granularity === "checkpoint"` ONLY — the last_turn default path (construction-safe), the last_turn nuclear path (step-5b), and the last_tool_call_group path are unchanged.

resolvePreview's widened return (remove + messages) is backward-compatible: all existing test/tools/rewind.test.ts tests stay green (hideEntryIds capture, K=0 honesty, best-effort getBranch-throws, step-5b nuclear, checkpoint success, mutation warning, never-throws, result shape).

The resolvePreview catch path sets remove=[] and messages=[] so a snapshot failure fails-open (iLatestUser=-1 → guard no-op; tool still succeeds E13/E8; the filter's protectedOk is the authoritative backstop).

No new imports added (MessageLike already in scope); the guard reuses the existing refusal() helper and the existing `config`; never throws (E13 — sits inside rewindExecute's outer try/catch with a defensive role read).

`npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `npx vitest run test/tools/rewind.test.ts` green; `npx vitest run` full suite green (baseline 684 → 687). Only src/tools/rewind.ts and test/tools/rewind.test.ts are modified.
